en_title: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey Sparks Assassin's Creed: Odyssey Player Count Spike, Gives Ubisoft 'Great Ammunition' for a Remake
cn_title: 《奥德赛》上映带动《刺客信条：奥德赛》玩家激增，育碧获重制版「绝佳弹药」
subtitle: 重返希腊
opus_summary: 克里斯托弗·诺兰《奥德赛》上映后，育碧《刺客信条：奥德赛》活跃玩家近乎翻倍。分析师Rhys Elliot认为，这为日后推出类似《刺客信条：黑旗 记忆重置》的重制版提供了有力依据。

paragraphs.en: Ubisoft's excellent Assassin's Creed Odyssey is enjoying a big spike in active players, following the launch of Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey .
paragraphs.cn: 克里斯托弗·诺兰的《奥德赛》上映后，育碧广受好评的《刺客信条：奥德赛》活跃玩家数大幅攀升。

paragraphs.en: Nolan's Ancient Greek blockbuster is on track to make a billion dollars at the box office, and has clearly sparked further interest in its setting. Indeed, engagement statistics published by Alinea Analytics analyst Rhys Elliot show that the film's launch has also driven thousands of players back to Ubisoft's 2018 epic.
paragraphs.cn: 诺兰这部以古希腊为背景的大片票房有望达到10亿美元(约合人民币68亿元)，显然也进一步激起了人们对其故事舞台的兴趣。事实上，Alinea Analytics分析师Rhys Elliot公布的互动数据表明，这部电影上映还让数千名玩家重返育碧2018年的这部史诗之作。

paragraphs.en: Assassin's Creed Odyssey has nearly doubled its active userbase over the past week across a combination of PlayStation, Xbox and PC via Steam. Xbox engagement was particularly strong, up from 36,000 to 84,000 daily active users, a leap of 134%.
paragraphs.cn: 过去一周，《刺客信条：奥德赛》在PlayStation、XBOX以及通过Steam游玩的PC平台上，活跃用户总数几乎翻了一倍。XBOX平台的互动尤其强劲，日活跃用户从36,000增至84,000，增幅达134%。

paragraphs.en: In what seems to be a canny move, Ubisoft currently has Assassin's Creed Odyssey available via Xbox Game Pass and PlayStation Plus — allowing The Odyssey fans who own a console subscription to boot up the game without any additional charge.
paragraphs.cn: 看起来颇为精明的是，育碧目前已通过XBOX Game Pass和PlayStation Plus提供《刺客信条：奥德赛》，让订阅主机服务的《奥德赛》影迷无需额外付费即可启动这款游戏。

paragraphs.en: "Software sales moved modestly at around 400,000 copies year-to-date, but the real [benefit] here is pure player engagement," Elliot wrote , going on to suggest the figures bode well for a future Odyssey remake akin to the recently-launched Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced.
paragraphs.cn: Rhys Elliot写道：「今年迄今的软件销量表现平平，约为400,000份，但这里真正的［收益］在于纯粹的玩家参与度。」他接着表示，这些数据预示着未来推出一款类似近期发售的《刺客信条：黑旗 记忆重置》的《奥德赛》重制版前景良好。

paragraphs.en: "The film didn't make millions buy an eight-year-old game, but it got a massive cohort playing it again," Elliot continued. "That data gives Ubisoft great ammunition for an eventual AC Odyssey Resynced.
paragraphs.cn: Rhys Elliot继续说道：「这部电影并没有让数百万人去买一款已有八年历史的游戏，却让一大批玩家重新玩起了它。这些数据为育碧最终推出《刺客信条：奥德赛 记忆重置》提供了绝佳弹药。」

paragraphs.en: "Credit to Ubisoft for leaning into the momentum. They ran timed social campaigns alongside Nolan’s release and resurfaced Discovery Tour (the guided, combat-free educational mode), positioning it as an interactive companion piece for anyone falling down a history rabbit hole after leaving the cinema."
paragraphs.cn: 「要称赞育碧顺势而为。他们配合诺兰电影上映开展了定时社交媒体宣传，并重新推出探索之旅（引导式、无战斗的教育模式），把它定位为互动式配套内容，供所有走出影院后沉浸于历史考据的人体验。」

paragraphs.en: Time to begin an Odyssey (again). pic.twitter.com/VKFlTOJrVq
paragraphs.cn: 是时候（再次）开启一段《奥德赛》之旅了。

paragraphs.en: Assassin's Creed Odyssey is an epic, standout entry in Ubisoft's long-lived historical adventure series, and one that's well worth experiencing (or revisiting, if you played it back in the day). It features an enormous world to explore, filled with a sprawling set of stories taking in the setting's historical characters, myths and legends. Odyssey also saw the series leaning its furthest into full RPG territory, to the delight of many (though the chagrin of others who preferred the franchise in its more humbler rooftop-set origins).
paragraphs.cn: 《刺客信条：奥德赛》是育碧长寿历史冒险系列中一部宏大而出色的作品，非常值得体验；如果你当年玩过，也值得重温。它拥有可供探索的庞大世界，铺陈出大量故事，囊括了该时代的历史人物、神话与传说。《奥德赛》也让该系列最深入地走向完整RPG路线，令许多玩家欣喜，却也让偏爱该系列早年朴素屋顶跑酷起源的其他玩家感到不满。

paragraphs.en: With more than 10 million copies sold during its first two years, Odyssey remains one of the most successful entries in the Assassin's Creed series, while its protagonist Kassandra continues to be one of its most popular, and one of the few to pop up again in subsequent games.
paragraphs.cn: 《奥德赛》在发售头两年销量超过1,000万份，至今仍是《刺客信条》系列最成功的作品之一；其主角卡珊德拉也依然是最受欢迎的角色之一，并且是少数会在后续游戏中再次登场的角色。

paragraphs.en: Just don't expect the events of either The Odyssey or Assassin's Creed Odyssey to overlap. While some elements will be familiar, the former is set around 800 years before — although it clearly inspired Ubisoft's game. Both stories follow an outcast navigating the Greek islands on a ship, battling armies and other monstrous forces as they attempt to reclaim their family. Not played Assassin's Creed Odyssey yet? Now's the time.
paragraphs.cn: 不过别期待《奥德赛》与《刺客信条：奥德赛》的事件会发生交集。两者虽有一些熟悉的元素，但前者的故事设定早了约800年——尽管它显然启发了育碧的游戏。两个故事都讲述一名被放逐者乘船穿行希腊群岛，在试图夺回家人的过程中与军队及其他怪物势力作战。还没玩过《刺客信条：奥德赛》？现在正是时候。
